name: Almorexant
summary: Almorexant (INN), also known by its development code ACT-078573, is an orexin antagonist, acting as a competitive antagonist of the OX1 and OX2 orexin receptors, which was being developed by the pharmaceutical companies Actelion and GSK for the treatment of insomnia.

pharmacology.text: Almorexant is a competitive, dual OX1 and OX2 receptor antagonist and selectively inhibits the functional consequences of OX1 and OX2 receptor activation, such as intracellular Ca2+ mobilization. It dissociates very slowly from the orexin receptors and this may prolong its duration of action.

summaryZh: 阿莫雷生，或譯阿莫倫特，是一種食慾素拮抗劑，可作為食慾素受體（OX1和OX2）的競爭性拮抗劑。該藥物由製藥公司Actelion和葛蘭素史克開發，用於治療失眠。由於在試驗中觀察到肝酶短暫升高後對阿莫雷生的肝臟安全性存在擔憂，該藥物的開發於2011年1月被中止。

sideEffects.en: Its development was stopped in 2011 over concerns about its tolerability. Drugs of its class, the orexin antagonists, can cause next-day drowsiness, headache, vivid dreams and, rarely, sleep paralysis.
sideEffects.zh: 阿莫雷生的開發在 2011 年因耐受性疑慮而中止。同類藥物食慾素拮抗劑可能造成隔天嗜睡、頭痛、鮮明的夢境，少數情況下會出現睡眠癱瘓（鬼壓床）。
sideEffects.zhHans: 阿莫雷生的开发在 2011 年因耐受性疑虑而中止。同类药物食欲素拮抗剂可能造成隔天嗜睡、头痛、鲜明的梦境，少数情况下会出现睡眠瘫痪（鬼压床）。

fact.en: Orexin, the brain signal it blocks, was discovered in 1998 by two teams at almost the same time. One named it orexin, from the Greek word for appetite, while the other called it hypocretin.
fact.zh: 阿莫雷生所阻斷的腦內訊號食慾素，在 1998 年幾乎同時被兩個團隊發現。一隊依希臘文「食慾」將它命名為 orexin，另一隊則稱它為 hypocretin。
fact.zhHans: 阿莫雷生所阻断的脑内信号食欲素，在 1998 年几乎同时被两个团队发现。一队依希腊文「食欲」将它命名为 orexin，另一队则称它为 hypocretin。
